verdict.rationale: Notte's own agent capability takes natural-language web tasks and runs them in cloud browsers. The docs show this with a multi-step example (go to LinkedIn, log in with credentials, extract messages) and an agent-start API. However, the evidence does not explicitly document general form filling or click-through flows, and one hands-on report says an extraction attempt on hyatt.com failed completely. missing for 10: explicit documentation of form filling and multi-page click-through flows, independent hands-on corroboration of successful end-to-end task completion, and reliability evidence that addresses the reported failure.

support.subject: As a developer, I can hand the product a natural-language goal and it completes a multi-step web task end to end — navigating, filling forms, and clicking through flows

citations.quote: Give AI agents natural language tasks to complete on websites
Describe a task. Watch it happen. One prompt. No selectors, no maintenance.
Got to linkedin.com, login with the credentials and extract the last 10 messages from my most recent conversation
run web ai agents to act on your behalf on the internet
